name: WakeMed Junior Volunteer Program (High School)
what_you_do: High school students volunteer one set day each week. They serve at a WakeMed campus for at least six months. Openings are competitive. They are posted only when positions are open.
grades: High school, through the summer after graduation
who_can_apply: High school students age 16 or older (the page covers ages 16 through the summer after graduation). Needs a Social Security Number or ITIN and Occupational Health clearance. Apply to only one location: Raleigh Campus or Cary Hospital.
duration: Minimum 6 months, one day a week on a regular set day and time
deadline_text: Applications open on the 15th of Oct, Dec, Feb, Apr, Jun and Aug for about 24 to 48 hours. Both campuses showed closed on Oct 16, 2026. Next check date: Dec 15, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online for one campus while it is open. If picked, you interview, give two references, get health checks and go to orientation.
notes: Not first come, first served. It takes 3 to 5 weeks. You need flu, MMR, Varicella, Tdap and TB clearance. Not for court-ordered service. Check dates may change.
